evidence.positive:
Against the running main build, staged a 50 kg adult (ideal weight 75 kg, so recorded weight is used) at demo-demo and at mayo-mayo via the admin patient/operation API, opened a selection tab for m-bupivacaine-liposome through POST /api/cds/medication-selection, then ran the save-time check through POST /api/cds/medication-dose (NERVE_BLOCK, mg). 266 mg returned no alert at both sites; the persisted not-fired explanation for a-local-anesthetic-max-dose-save reads 'Given dose (266 mg) ≤ remaining dose (266 mg) + buffer (5 mg)'. 300 mg fired the rule at both sites ('Reduce Bupivacaine Dose') with details MAX_DOSE_MG=266, MAX_DOSE_BASIS='266 mg', no MAX_DOSE_MG_PER_KG and no CALCULATION_SCALES_WITH_WEIGHT. A 120 kg adult at demo (WEIGHT_TYPE 'ideal weight') gave the identical 266 / '266 mg' result, so the maximum is weight-independent. Mayo 5-day lookback: a 133 mg liposomal bolus recorded 48 h earlier via /api/admin/bolus was counted — the selection-time w-last-local-anesthetic-max-dose fired with max 266 mg, remaining 133 mg, banner 'Max dose is 133 mg.' listing the prior dose, and the save check then alerted at 266 mg and passed 133 mg with EXPANDED_CALCULATION 'Bupivacaine Liposome max dose = 266 mg
133 mg ÷ 266 mg = 50%'. DB check: in demo-demo, mayo-mayo, mgb-mgh and mgb-icsnh every liposomal record (m-bupivacaine-liposome, g-exparel, g-bupivacaine-liposome) has primary_medication_category BUPIVACAINE_LIPOSOME and no medication, category row or category link named EXPAREL exists in any schema.
evidence.negative: A 133 mg liposomal bolus recorded 6 days earlier at mayo-mayo was not counted: the save check at 266 mg returned no alert with explanation 'Given dose (266 mg) ≤ remaining dose (266 mg) + buffer (5 mg)', i.e. the lookback stops at 5 days. The ideal-weight citation path is skipped for the fixed maximum: the 120 kg adult firing carried WEIGHT_TYPE 'ideal weight' but no CALCULATION_SCALES_WITH_WEIGHT key. Doses at or under the 266 mg maximum (121, 199, 266 mg) never alerted at either site once the fix was in place.
evidence.red_check: Two flips, both reverted and re-verified. (1) Data flip — the ticket's Mayo example: updated mayo-mayo.medications and medications_medication_categories so m-bupivacaine-liposome carried primary category BUPIVACAINE (the pre-fix state). A fresh 50 kg Mayo adult then alerted at 266 mg with MAX_DOSE_MG=125, MAX_DOSE_BASIS='2.5 mg/kg × 50 kg recorded weight', and a 121 mg dose logged 'Given dose (121 mg) ≤ remaining dose (125 mg) + buffer (5 mg)'; with the same flip a prior 133 mg bolus at 48 h was ignored by the selection rule (24 h lookback, max 125 mg, no prior listed). Reverted the row (category, category id back to its original null, categories json, link row), confirmed it matched the fleet, and a fresh 50 kg Mayo adult again passed 266 mg and showed remaining 266 for 121 mg. (2) Class swap — the removed 4 mg/kg adult clause: compiled LASTProtocolService with the pediatric guard removed (so adults get min(4 mg/kg × weight, 266 mg), the pre-fix rule; logger written out explicitly because lombok is not on the runtime classpath), backed up the shipped class in the container (md5 71be1e0256b9365a892de675073e1828), swapped the six LASTProtocolService*.class files into /app/classes and restarted. A fresh 50 kg demo adult then alerted at 266 mg with MAX_DOSE_MG=200, MAX_DOSE_BASIS='4 mg/kg × 50 kg recorded weight', and 199 mg logged 'remaining dose (200 mg)'. Restored the backed-up classes (md5 back to 71be1e0256b9365a892de675073e1828), restarted, and a fresh 50 kg demo adult passed 199 and 266 mg and alerted only at 300 mg with the 266 mg basis.

caveats: Pediatric behavior was not exercised at runtime: the product carries only an ADULT dosing config at demo and Mayo, so a pediatric patient's save check fails with 'No dosing config found for medication: m-bupivacaine-liposome' and the selection rules return nothing; the code ships 4 mg/kg up to 266 mg for pediatrics while the ticket still lists the pediatric answer as TBD (Alex, 2026-11-04).

MGB tenants were verified at the data level only (g-exparel and g-bupivacaine-liposome carry BUPIVACAINE_LIPOSOME, no EXPAREL anywhere); those records are generic entries with no routes or dosing config, so no MGB dose check was run. The 4 mg/kg red check ran at demo.
Validation went through the real selection and dose-check endpoints and the persisted rule results, not a rendered browser; the alert title and banner HTML were read from API responses.
The 4 mg/kg red check used the shipped class with only the pediatric guard removed rather than the true parent-commit class, whose constructor and method signatures no longer load against this build.

Every liposomal evaluation logs a WARN 'Unexpected concentration units for medication m-bupivacaine-liposome: mg/mL (expected '%')' and falls back to the mg-only calculation; the result is still correct and this predates the ticket.
The spec delta in the four rule specs was seen in the merged diff only; it has no runtime surface.
w-last-local-anesthetic-max-dose was observed at selection; i-last-local-anesthetic was not separately asserted.

automation.assessment: qa-suite coverage is LAMD-001 only (plain bupivacaine, UI driven, demo tenant); nothing covers liposomal bupivacaine, the fixed 266 mg maximum, or the 5-day lookback. The browser-free API path used here (admin stage -> /api/cds/medication-selection -> /api/cds/medication-dose -> /api/admin/rule/evaluations/fired and not-fired) runs in about a second per case and can lock in every adult scenario validated. Java unit coverage for the calculation already exists in the PR (LocalAnestheticLiposomalBupivacaineMaxDoseTest, LASTProtocolServiceTest), so the value is end-to-end wiring at demo, where m-bupivacaine-liposome is now selectable.

LAMD-003 @supplemental: 120 kg adult (ideal weight applies) gets the same 266 mg maximum and basis '266 mg', and the firing carries no CALCULATION_SCALES_WITH_WEIGHT.

LAMD-004 @supplemental: a 133 mg liposomal bolus 48 h earlier is counted (w-last-local-anesthetic-max-dose banner 'Max dose is 133 mg.' at selection; save check alerts at 266 mg and passes 133 mg), while the same bolus 6 days earlier is ignored (266 mg passes).

jira_comment:
Verdict: deploy-ready.

Positive: A 50 kg and a 120 kg adult at demo and at Mayo both pass 266 mg of liposomal bupivacaine and alert at 300 mg with a flat 266 mg basis, a prior dose 48 hours earlier is counted at Mayo, and no product at any site carries EXPAREL.
Negative: A prior dose 6 days earlier is ignored, and doses at or under 266 mg never alert.
Red check: With Mayo's product flipped back to the BUPIVACAINE category a 50 kg adult alerted at 266 mg against a 125 mg (2.5 mg/kg) maximum and lost the 48-hour prior dose, and with the 4 mg/kg adult clause restored in the service the same patient alerted against 200 mg; both were reverted and re-verified.

Automation: Four supplemental API-level LAMD tests are proposed for the fixed maximum, weight independence, the 5-day lookback and the category rename; pediatric remains unverifiable until the product gets a pediatric dosing config and the ticket's pediatric answer is confirmed.
